summary: Birthday has several regional versions. A common one touches the middle finger of an open hand to the chin and then the chest, from BIRTH plus DAY, or the clip's regional form.
steps: Watch the clip for the version we filmed.
Note where it touches and in what order.
HAPPY BIRTHDAY is HAPPY followed by this sign.
note: Birthday is one of the most regionally variable signs in ASL. If someone signs it differently, they're not wrong; they're from somewhere else.
mistakes: Insisting on one version. Learn the one you see most locally.
